summary: Migrate .omc/registries/ to registries/cross-cutting/ per doctrine P11/P14. 13 files moved. Cross-ref rewrite via 2-pass sed: Rust = registries/cross-cutting/ (no leading slash, for Path::join), non-Rust = /registries/cross-cutting/ (leading slash, doctrine convention). Critical verification: seam lane reads registries/cross-cutting/dependency-rationales.json successfully — 30 tests pass; oya-dev-cli pass; oya-check-cedar-fragment-coverage pass; workspace check clean.

findings: 2-pass sed (split by Rust vs non-Rust) was the right call — Path::join semantics require no leading slash
~85 files rewritten in 2 sed invocations; scales
seam lane registry-coverage sub-check now reads from new path; if path were wrong, lane would fail — verified 30 tests pass
